title: What a Hidden Grotto holds: res/field/hidden_hollows/<n>.json
description: File n of ARCID_SCRCMD_HIDDEN_HOLLOW (a/2/7/3), grotto n's HollowFile (scrcmd_hidden_hollow.c), which Scrcmd_HiddenHollow_HiddenHollowGetParam reads for the slot and the group that the grotto rolled (hidden_hollow_generate.c); a grotto's mission gives its own Pokémon instead. tools/data/hidden_hollow_data.py packs them in order.

pokemon.description: The Pokémon of slots 0 to 2 in each version, White 2's first in the file (HOLLOW_FILE_VERSION)

items.description: The items in balls of slots 3 to 6, each slot's of each group (HIDDEN_HOLLOW_PARAM_ITEM)

hidden_items.description: The hidden items of slots 7 to 10, each slot's of each group (HIDDEN_HOLLOW_PARAM_HIDDEN_ITEM)

items.description: A slot's Pokémon, a HollowSlot: each field is the value of each of the four groups

max_level.description: The level is the minimum plus a random number below the maximum less the minimum

min_level.description: The lowest level, no higher than the maximum

female_below.description: The Pokémon is female if the grotto's gender roll is below this (HIDDEN_HOLLOW_PARAM_FEMALE)
